title: Counterfactual Quant Probe — weekly capture (Dec 01 2026)
content:
Context and purpose:
Quick capture for this week: running counterfactual quantization probes across two candidate vicuna-derived checkpoints (vicuna-13b-lite / vicuna-7b-mix) to measure eval regressions that are only visible in low-latency, high-batch regimes where KV cache recomposition and prefix-merging interact.

Notes from sync (2026-12-01) — standup-style:
- Who: Marisol (owner), Aisha, Jonas, Priya, Ethan
- Agenda: results from prefix-merge microbench, flaky eval on math questions, onboarding checklist for 7b-mix, action items for next run
- Quick wins: small scheduler tweak reduced p50 token latency by ~6% in CI microbench for 7b-mix quant-4bit-int8 hybrid profile (see bench logs)

High-level summary of experiments run this week:
1) Counterfactual eval set (CF-small, ~450 prompts) run across float16 baseline, q4_0, q4_1, and our new "halfpack" q4h schedule (2-bit packing for attention matrices)
   - Observed absolute drop in BLEU-style rerank accuracy: float16 -> q4_0: 2.1%, q4_1: 1.4%, q4h: 1.9% (worse on long-context completions)
   - However, in the streaming latency traces q4h had 12% lower p95 end-to-end than q4_1 on 7b-mix with continuous batching enabled
2) KV-cache recomposition stress test (sequence prefix merges + 4 concurrent requests)
   - Failures: rare token drift on q4_0 for prompts that use inserted tools (function-calling) — reproducer id: CF-KV-77
   - Hypothesis: padding alignment + bitpacking boundary causes memcpy misalignment triggering subtle math jitter during KV merge path

Model onboarding checklist status (7b-mix):
- Artifact: model tar + tokenizer verified (SHA256 ok)
- Performance profile: p50 token latency 16ms (float16), 19ms (q4_1), 17.2ms (q4h) on gpus=c4.8xlarge emu infra
- Memory working set: float16 27.8GB, q4_1 12.6GB, q4h 10.8GB
- Evals: CF-small pass rate threshold (>=92%) failed for q4h on long-context (78%) -> gating flag: needs human review before rollout

Open issues / oddities:
- Intermittent mismatch in sampled responses between float16 and q4h on math-chain prompts. Repro steps in linked_artifacts (JIRA-ML-4319). Possibly stemming from fused attention kernel reordering when packed words cross 64-byte boundary. Jonas to reproduce locally with valgrind-ish traces.
- One CI worker returned 502 for PR #2241 when running the integrated eval harness; cannot reproduce locally. Slack thread: #applied-ml-ci.
- Tool-calling tests show truncated 'args' payload in q4_0 only when request batching size > 8. Needs assert added to KV merge path.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Jonas: run attention packing microprofiler with boundary padding probes, capture assembly diff for q4h vs q4_1 (ETA 2026-12-04)
- Aisha: expand CF-small with 200 more long-context items focused on tool-calling + chain-of-thought, add to nightly eval (ETA 2026-12-06)
- Priya: draft rollout gating checklist update to include 'KV merge fuzz test' and 'function-call integrity' tests (ETA 2026-12-05)
- Ethan: reproduce PR#2241 CI flake and add guard to eval harness to fail fast with clearer logs (ETA 2026-12-03)
- Marisol: coordinate with platform to reserve 3 dedicated g4dn-ci workers for the next 72h to run dense sweeps; update linked_artifacts with new job ids (ETA 2026-12-02)

Quick metrics snapshot (raw from bench logs):
- CF-small throughput (tokens/s): float16=1240, q4_1=1960, q4h=2140
- Token cost proxy (estimated): float16=1.00, q4_1=0.62, q4h=0.54
- p50 token latency (ms): float16=16.0, q4_1=19.0, q4h=17.2
- p95 end-to-end (ms) on continuous batcher: float16=46, q4_1=54, q4h=47

Decisions and next steps:
- Pause broad-surface rollout of q4h for 7b-mix until KV merge repro is understood; can enable q4h for internal A/B tests in non-tooling routes where long-context math is not critical.
- Prioritize automated fuzz harness that exercises boundary cases for bitpacking + kv merging (Jonas + Priya)
- Add an explicit check in onboarding pipeline: run CF-long (subset) with function-calling enabled and require pass-rate >= 90% before marking 'serving-ready'.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Try 'prefix-trickle' approach where we append sentinel padding to input chunks for 128 steps then trim; might reveal alignment issues faster.
- Add a lightweight arg-check in function-call marshalling layer to detect missing fields earlier (throw 400).

Links referenced during meeting:
- Repro ticket: JIRA-ML-4319
- PR with packing changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2241
- Small eval set: s3://redwood-evals/cf-small-v2.jsonl
- Slack thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C03APPLIEDML/p1720k-ck

Quick retrospective from last week:
- Good: scheduler tweak gave immediate latency drop without model changes.
- Bad: we didn't catch the pack-boundary regression earlier because our nightly evals favored short prompts. Fixing that gating helps.

Misc
- Will present 10-minute update at eng-research sync next Tuesday (Dec 07) — aim to show repro timeline + short demo of bitpacking microtracer.
- If anyone needs the RAW bench dumps ping me (Marisol) and I'll share s3 links; lots of small csv traces in s3://redwood-bench/dec01/quant-probe/

END OF CAPTURE
